concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe visibly plumper, brighter, and more hydrated under-eyes after 30 minutes of wear; no dissent reported on this point.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports mild stinging and irritation with no visible redness, leading her to return the product; others report no irritation at all.

aspects.libelle: Serum dries and pills if left too long

extraits.texte: Sad to return - these irritated my skin. No redness, just mild stinging.

If the silicone pads sit too long (10 mins or more), the serum eventually dries out and starts to pill all over the face. If serum is still wet, I pat around my eyes, but it eventually leaves a film behind… not sure if I wanna return the product yet

I personally needed an eye patch that didn't have any crazy ingredients because I use them when I'm up late doing work, and I don't want it to interfere with my regular skincare. So A+ for no crazy actives or anything. But, the patches are sooooo slimy, they fall off and get everywhere. I do really like the thickness and texture of the patch, though. I just wish this wasn't so messy.

First time eye patch user and I'm hooked! They stay on perfectly and feel very refreshing. They are very wet but they feel great. I was able to do my morning routine while wearing these for 30 minutes. My under eye are looks fresh and bright! I will make these part of my morning routine!

I bought this because i was interested in trying out the brand and i am pleasantly surprised!! These patches stick on so well and don't slide around. After leaving them on for 30 minutes i could visibly see plumper under eyes and really nice hydration without being slimy or sticky. Plus, i really love the aesthetics of the packaging
Very soothing eye pads and I like that they pretty much melt into your skin. Leaving my under eyes so refreshed and hydrated!

reserve: The 9 reviews rarely state the reviewer's skin type, so segmentation by skin type could not be produced from this set.
